Don’t Miss 7th Heaven!
Mar 2025 • Couples
After travelling for two months through South East Asia we came across 7th Heaven in Dong Hoi. We ordered something we had in quite some time Chicken Fingers and Bruschetta. Odd combination but it sure hits the spot! Menu consists of a wide variety of Western and Asian cuisine at extremely reasonable prices. Service was friendly and quick! Located in a quiet residential neighbourhood in Dong Hoi this quaint spot should not be missed.
